description: Prepare a message to the dealer about one car on the shopper's behalf: availability, out-the-door price with fees, add-ons, history. Returns the exact message for the shopper to review. In this version the message is a preview and is not sent. Ask the shopper before calling this, and never invent their name or contact.

contact.description: Email or mobile number the shopper wants answers sent to, as they gave it.

first_name.description: The shopper's first name, as they gave it.

note.description: Anything else the shopper wants asked, in their words.

questions.description: What to ask. Default: availability and out-the-door price.

name: start_inquiry
title: Ask the dealer about a car
